description: Local Council Waste and Resource Recovery Data, NSW is a collection of resources listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by NSW Environmental Protection Authority. The NSW Environmental Protection Authority (EPA) publishes local council data on domestic waste and recycling. Data is published annually based on voluntary survey responses from NSW local councils. Alongside a written report (PDF), each release includes data tables (Excel format) with extensive information for each Local Government Area (LGA). Coverage is the states and territories, 2005 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-10-06. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
